recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. Any current revisit of media-like workflow behavior should be handled through active successors such as DocumentReference or Observation, or through a new workflow-pattern decision, not this retired STU3 Media cleanup issue.
issue_request: FHIR-15600 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by OO. It asked to accept all Media column-H workflow-report changes from the attached spreadsheet under GF#14450/FHIR-14450, noting one breaking value-set reassignment and otherwise validation/warning cleanup.
initial_application: The broader GF#14450 Media workflow work was pre-applied in commits f35985eb6662dbbd4a3e5a2a9935408ea7246068 and 5617cb18f00ef310bcf89d15d832b70ff1def0f2. Commit bca007c5c2fb48a994c037fb3ff8a93c6f0fded6 added Media workflow warning suppressions, and direct #GF15600 follow-up commit 29930b92ad646b70ddbfb2aea6cdc6230897ddb4 updated shared event-pattern instantiates extension naming.
additional_context: FHIR-14450 is the parent OO workflow tracker and lists Media GF#15600 as the resource-specific slice. Current source still contains legacy Media files and Media warning suppressions, but source/fhir.ini no longer has an active media=Media entry. GF#19250/FHIR-19250 later removed Media from the active resource list and source/history.html points implementers to DocumentReference or Observation. FHIR-15605 is adjacent Media type/value-set work already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reapplying the old workflow report would target retired Media source files or duplicate legacy warning suppressions that no longer affect an active Media resource.
